name: SEOmatic
description: SEO agent for your own site: real Search Console, keyword, backlink and AI-visibility data in your AI assistant, plus approval-gated fixes, articles and campaigns. OAuth, free to connect.
author: SEOmatic

tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Research keyword demand: search volume, difficulty, CPC, and intent, plus keyword ideas, Google Trends interest and related queries, and Google Ads keyword performance. Use for what to target and how much demand exists; for who ranks today use serp_competitors. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. metrics (volume/difficulty/CPC/intent); suggestions (keyword ideas from seeds); compare_trends (Trends interest, keywords side by side); trend (Trends interest over time for one keyword); related (Trends related queries).

keywords.description: metrics/suggestions/compare_trends: the seed or target keywords.

keyword.description: trend/related: the single keyword to analyze.

tools.name: keyword_clusters
tools.description: The agent's cached keyword-cluster map built from the workspace's GSC query universe (pillar, cannibalization, gap, and covered clusters). Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

tools.name: backlink_profile
tools.description: Read the backlink profile of your own site or any competitor: referring domains, anchor-text distribution, link velocity, and link-prospect intersects. Use for authority and link questions; for rankings use serp_competitors. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. summary (totals, referring domains, rank/spam); anchors (anchor-text distribution); velocity (monthly new vs lost referring domains); referring_domains (top linking domains); link_prospects (link intersect: linking to competitors but not to us).

domain.description: The domain to analyze, e.g. "example.com". Omit it to analyze the connected workspace's own site (the server fills it in); pass it only to analyze a competitor.

competitors.description: link_prospects only: 1-3 competitor domains to intersect against.

tools.name: serp_competitors
tools.description: Inspect the live search landscape: which SERP features (AI Overview, snippet, PAA, local pack, video) appear for a keyword, plus domain-level top rankings, visibility distribution, and competitor domains. Use for who ranks and why; for keyword demand use keyword_research. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. features (which SERP features appear for a keyword); domain_rankings (top keywords a domain ranks for); domain_overview (organic visibility distribution); domain_competitors (domains ranking for similar keywords).

keywords.description: features only: the keyword(s) to inspect.

domain.description: domain_rankings/domain_overview/domain_competitors: the domain. Omit for the connected workspace's own site (the server fills it in); pass only for a competitor.

tools.name: local_presence
tools.description: Read the local search presence of the connected business: Business Profile locations, local ranking for money keywords, and review ratings. Available actions depend on what is connected for this workspace. Use for local and map-pack questions; for national rankings use serp_competitors. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. visibility (local organic position for keywords).

keywords.description: visibility only: the money keywords to measure.

tools.name: site_pages
tools.description: Analyze pages: on-page SEO score and critical issues for a URL, raw crawl metadata (title, meta, headings, links), and the page inventory of the site. Use for page-level diagnosis; for search performance of those pages use gsc_performance. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. analyze (SEO score + critical issues); crawl (title/meta/headings/links); inventory (the user's real synced pages).

limit.description: inventory only: max pages to return.

tools.name: dataset_library
tools.description: The dataset library and page templates that power programmatic pages: list datasets, sample rows, list templates, and read one template. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. list_datasets (available datasets); dataset_rows (sample rows from one dataset); list_templates (built-in page templates); get_template (one template in full).

datasetId.description: dataset_rows only: the dataset to sample.

templateId.description: get_template only: the template to read.

limit.description: dataset_rows only: how many rows to sample.

tools.name: strategy_insights
tools.description: The agent's cached diagnosis for this workspace: a compact snapshot, the current strategy, one raw signal in full, and AI-search content scores. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. snapshot (compact brief of cached signals); strategy (themes + ranked big plays); signal (one cached signal in full); content_scores (AI-search scores for generated articles).

signal.description: signal only: which cached signal to read (e.g. index_coverage, backlink_profile).

tools.name: task_manage
tools.description: Read the agent's plan board and stage new SEO task proposals. Proposals NEVER execute: each is an approval-gated card the user reviews. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. list (the plan board (filterable)); get (one task in full detail); create (stage up to 5 task proposals); decide (approve or dismiss a staged proposal (the approval loop)).

status.description: list only: filter by task status (proposed, approved, ...).

type.description: list only: filter by task type.

taskId.description: get/decide: the task to read or decide.

decision.description: decide only: approve releases the task to the gated pipeline; dismiss archives it. Indexation-destructive types are refused over the API.

tasks.description: create only: up to 5 task objects to stage as proposals (see the SEOmatic docs for the task shape).

tools.name: campaign_manage
tools.description: Read campaigns and stage page-scale, content-sweep, or bulk-edit campaigns and blog articles. All staging is proposal-based and approval-gated; nothing publishes without the user. Already scoped to the connected workspace and its site; call directly, no domain or site parameter is needed.

action.description: Which operation to run. list (campaigns with status + task counts); manage (pause/resume/abandon/update a campaign); propose_page_scale (programmatic landing pages at scale); propose_content_sweep (N distinct blog articles as a campaign); propose_bulk_edit (one instruction across many pages); write_articles (direct N-article staging).

status.description: list only: filter campaigns by status.

campaignId.description: manage only: the campaign to act on.

manageAction.description: manage only: what to do to the campaign.

confirm.description: manage + abandon only: must be true to confirm the irreversible action.

brief.description: manage+update_brief: replacement brief. Also propose_page_scale (template brief) and propose_content_sweep (shared direction).

kind.description: propose_page_scale only (required): page kind, e.g. "location pages".

rowSourceKind.description: propose_page_scale only (required): where page rows come from.

rows.description: propose_page_scale, rowSourceKind=user: one object per page.

libraryDatasetId.description: propose_page_scale, rowSourceKind=library: dataset id to attach.

rowTarget.description: propose_page_scale only: target number of rows/pages.

allowGenText.description: propose_page_scale only: allow per-row AI text (costs credits).

publishAsDraft.description: propose_page_scale only: publish pages as drafts.

topics.description: propose_content_sweep (required, up to 50) and write_articles (required, 2-50). One distinct article per topic.

taskType.description: propose_bulk_edit only (required): the sweep type, e.g. ctr_fix, schema, content_refresh.

selectorKind.description: propose_bulk_edit only: how to select pages.

maxPages.description: propose_bulk_edit only: cap the sweep size.

autoPublish.description: write_articles only: default false (stage as drafts).

tools.name: show_approval_cards
tools.description: Render inline Approve/Dismiss cards for EXISTING proposed tasks and campaigns (get ids from list_seo_tasks / list_seo_campaigns first). Call this whenever the user wants to see, review, or act on proposals that already exist — the cards appear directly in your reply. NEVER send the user to the dashboard to approve something; this brings the approval to the conversation.
